tasks.title: Render performance pass: LOD + instancing audit
tasks.detail: A 900 m city is 3.7M triangles and renders slowly on CPU. Audit which collections dominate, push far geometry to LOD proxies, and confirm every repeated object is a linked duplicate rather than a copy.

notes.text: claimed

Audit tool added (tools/perf_audit.py): per-collection triangles, mesh-datablock counts, instancing ratio, and a duplicate-geometry detector keyed on a geometry signature. First finding: vehicles were not instanced at all. vehicles._place rebuilt the bmesh for every placement, so each car got its own datablock - 156 identical parked sedans meant 156 BVH builds and 156 copies of one shape. Fixed with a prototype cache (vehicles.place_instanced) keyed on the factory identity; traffic.py's wrapper now routes through it (one line). Measured A/B at size 320, same scene: unique vehicle meshes 1731 -> 78, unique vehicle triangles 110,388 -> 4,928, total mesh datablocks 2,441 -> 788. Object count and scene triangles are byte-identical (regress --quick still la 3,421/1,678,478 and nyc 3,721/2,651,331), so this is pure memory and BVH savings with no visual change.

Second fix: distance LOD for the scanned library, which was the largest single slice of the budget at 46%. core.py already had ensure_lod_collections/move_to_lod but nothing ever called them - the LOD layer was dead code. assets_models.place() now swaps in a decimated proxy datablock (35% ratio, built once per source and shared) for any instance beyond LOD_RADIUS=95 m from origin, which is outside where the three street cameras stand; the aerial camera is far enough that the decimation is not resolvable. Result at size 320: CITY_Library 1,029,316 -> 472,460 tris (-54%), whole scene 2,221,064 -> 1,686,957 (-24%). Honoured --no-lod: gated on CONFIG['band_lod']. No baseline re-record needed - regress tracks per-collection OBJECT counts and those are unchanged; regress --size 200 PASSES and reports deterministic on re-run. Also stopped the audit flagging *_src prototype collections as 'not instanced' since one object per shape is correct there and they are hide_render.

Verified end to end: full master run at size 320 rendered all 4 cameras clean, no module errors, city.blend written (47.6 MB, down from 70 MB before the LOD pass). Peak Cycles memory 659 MB. Remaining hotspots for whoever picks this up next: CITY_Buildings is 20% of the budget at 1.00x instancing - that is inherent since every building is unique massing, but repeated roof/facade sub-parts inside it are duplicated datablocks and could be shared. CITY_Trees is 17.9% at 11.96x, already well instanced; it would need its own LOD tier to go lower. The _src prototype collections hold ~120k triangles that are hide_render (no render cost) but do inflate the .blend - purging them after build would shrink the file further.
completed
